stories.title: Define Multi-Cluster Routing Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define configuration schema for multiple MongoDB clusters including cluster roles (primary, secondary, analytics), dataset mappings (e.g., providers, embeddings, logs), routing rules, environment prefixes, and failover policies. Establish a strict contract for how services request a cluster (by capability or dataset type).

stories.title: Implement Cluster Routing and Selection Logic
stories.description: Build core routing engine that selects the correct MongoDB cluster based on request context (read/write, dataset type, environment). Include deterministic routing rules, cluster role awareness, and fallback handling for unavailable clusters.

stories.title: Integrate Routing Logic with Mongo Utilities
stories.description: Embed routing engine into shared MongoDB utilities so all database access flows through cluster selection. Ensure compatibility with existing connection lifecycle management, ping validation, and context manager patterns.

stories.title: Expose Routing Configuration and Health Signals
stories.description: Provide internal API/config access to expose active routing decisions, cluster mappings by dataset, and cluster health status for debugging and observability. Ensure read-only access and no external UI exposure.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Multi-Cluster Routing
stories.description: Create tests validating correct cluster selection across dataset types, read/write paths, and environments. Include failover scenarios and dual-cluster simulation to verify routing correctness and resilience.
